abstract.para: To monitor a single cluster, use the Status screen. After you log in to &hawk;, the Status screen is displayed by default. An icon in the upper-left corner shows the cluster status at a glance. Further details are shown in the following sections:

listitem.para: Cluster configuration errors are shown at the top of the page.

The Resources tab shows the configured resources including their Status, Name (ID), Location (node on which they are running), and resource agent Type. From the Operations column, you can start or stop a resource, trigger several actions, or view details. Actions that can be triggered include setting the resource to maintenance mode (or removing maintenance mode), migrating it to a different node, cleaning up the resource, showing any recent events, or editing the resource.

The Nodes tab shows the nodes belonging to the cluster site you are logged in to, including the nodes' Status and Name. In the Maintenance and Standby columns, you can set or remove the maintenance or standby flag for a node. The Operations column allows you to view recent events for the node or further details. For example, if a utilization, standby or maintenance attribute is set for the respective node.
If you create any resource tags, they will appear as additional tabs next to the Nodes tab.
